en: The Siddhamangala Stotra composed by the illustrious Madananta Śrīvibhuṣīta for King Appala Lakṣmī Narasiṃha: Victory! Be victorious! Be a conqueror of the quarters! O Illustrious One, be ever-victorious with unbroken glory! || 1 ||
Śrī Vidyādharī Rādhā, Surekhā, and the venerable feet of Śrī Rākhīdhara—be victorious, be triumphant, O illustrious and indivisible Śrī Vijayī! || 2 ||

Victory to the feet of Śrī, nourished by the nectar of maternal affection! O Mother Sumati, victory to you! Be victorious; be a conqueror of the quarters; be the glorious, all-encompassing, and illustrious Vijayin! 3.

O delighter of the daughters of the truthful lords of sages, O one whose glorious feet are praised by the teachers of the Bāpa lineage—victory to you! Be victorious! Be a conqueror of the quarters! Be the glorious, all-encompassing, and illustrious Vijayī! 4.

Born of the lineage of the sage Bhāradvāja, you are the performer of the Sāvitra and Kāṭhaka fire-piling rites; may you be victorious, may you be ever-conquering, may you be the glorious, all-encompassing, and illustrious victor! 5.

O God, whose four feet are adorned by the multitude of Lakṣmīs, whose glorious feet are known for their number; be victorious, be triumphant, be the conqueror of all directions, O possessor of splendor, be ever-victorious! 6.

O son of the illustrious Queen Mother, born as the fruit of the merit of your conception, you who are the very embodiment of virtue—be victorious, be ever-conquering, be a world-conqueror, and be the glorious possessor of unbroken, supreme victory! 7.

O delight of Sumati, O son of Narahari, O Lord Dattadeva, O illustrious one, victory to you! Be victorious, be a conqueror of the quarters; O glorious one, be victorious with unbroken splendor! || 8 ||
Pīṭhikāpurī, Nityavihārā, Madhumatī, Dattā, and Maṅgalā—victory! Be victorious! Be a conqueror of the quarters! O glorious and unbroken one, be victorious with glory! 9.
